ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

edits.expected: whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience
edits.replacement: whom I serve, as my forefathers did, with pure conscience
edits.reason: From my forefathers identifies continuity with ancestral service, not Paul personally living since his ancestors’ time. Preserve pure conscience and ongoing prayer without inventing ancestors’ names.

edits.expected: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
edits.replacement: And their word will eat away like gangrene: among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus;
edits.reason: Gangrene is a mass noun: my first proposal left a gangrene. The complete result removes the article and repairs plural agreement while retaining the destructive disease image.

edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.

edits.expected: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
edits.replacement: Flee also the wrongful desires of youth: but follow righteousness, faith, love, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
edits.reason: Lusts here are wrongful desires of youth, not limited to sexual impulses. The contrasting justice, faith, love and peace remain; no list of modern behaviors is inserted.
